description: This file defines a journaled Orleans grain called ChatGrain that manages chat messages stored as an XML document. It includes methods for initializing the chat, posting, deleting, and editing messages, and handles event sourcing with custom state transition logic.

classes.name: ChatGrain
classes.description: A journaled Orleans grain implementing a chat system with XML-based state, supporting posting, deleting, and editing messages, with event sourcing and custom state transition logic.

methods.name: OnActivateAsync
methods.description: Overrides the activation method to initialize the chat state if not already initialized, by raising a creation event.

methods.name: TransitionState
methods.description: Overrides the transition function to apply chat events to the XML document state.

methods.name: GetChat
methods.description: Returns the current chat XML document state.

methods.name: Post
methods.description: Raises an event to post a new chat message.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Raises an event to delete a chat message by GUID.

methods.name: Edit
methods.description: Raises an event to edit an existing chat message.
